question.problem: If $-\dfrac{3}{2}t = 24$, then what is the value of $t?$
question.worked_solution:
We multiply both sides of the equation by the reciprocal of $-\dfrac{3}{2},$ which is 

$$
\left( -\dfrac{3}{2} \right)^{-1} = -\dfrac{2}{3}.
$$

 This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}-\frac{3}{2}t & =24 \\ -\frac{2}{3}\cdot (-\frac{3}{2}t) & =-\frac{2}{3}\cdot 24 \\ 1t & =-\frac{2}{\cancel{3}}\cdot \cancel{3}\cdot 8 \\ t & =-16.\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
